articles.heading: Scope & Key Requirements (Public Summary)
articles.text: Sets out the coordinated 15% global minimum tax framework (Income Inclusion Rule — IIR, Undertaxed Profits Rule — UTPR, and Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax — QDMTT) for MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750 million. Directly linked to IAS 12 Pillar Two amendments.

articles.heading: 15% Global Minimum Tax: Scope, ETR Formula & Charging Order
articles.text:
• Scope (Art. 1.1): MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750 million in at least 2 of the 4 preceding fiscal years.
• Jurisdictional Effective Tax Rate (ETR) (Art. 5.1–5.2): Adjusted Covered Taxes ÷ Net GloBE Income per jurisdiction; if ETR < 15%, Top-up Tax Percentage = 15% − ETR applied to Excess Profit (Net GloBE Income minus Substance-based Income Exclusion for payroll & tangible assets).
• Charging rule order: (1) Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) collected locally first; (2) Income Inclusion Rule (IIR) at Ultimate Parent Entity; (3) Undertaxed Profits Rule (UTPR) backstop.
• Transitional CbCR Safe Harbours & IAS 12 link: temporary safe harbours simplify 2024–2026 compliance; accounting follows IAS 12.4A/88A–88D mandatory deferred tax exception.

articles.heading: Scope & Key Requirements (Public Summary)
articles.text: Global template for bilateral double taxation treaties covering residency, permanent establishment (PE), business profits, dividends/interest/royalties withholding tax, and mutual agreement procedures (MAP).

articles.heading: Key Treaty Articles: Residency, PE, Passive Income & MAP
articles.text:
• Art. 4 (Resident): tie-breaker rules for dual-resident individuals (permanent home, centre of vital interests) and entities (mutual agreement).
• Art. 5 & Art. 7 (Permanent Establishment & Business Profits): source country may tax business profits ONLY if attributable to a PE (fixed place of business, construction site >12 months, or dependent agent).
• Arts. 10–12 (Withholding Tax Caps): Dividends (5% substantial holding / 15% portfolio), Interest (10%), Royalties (0% in OECD Model; often 10% in bilateral treaties involving China).
• Art. 23 & Art. 25: Elimination of double taxation (exemption or credit method) and Mutual Agreement Procedure (MAP) for cross-border dispute resolution.

articles.heading: Scope & Key Requirements (Public Summary)
articles.text: Authoritative international guidance on the arm's length principle, comparability analysis, transfer pricing methods (CUP, RPM, CPLM, TNMM, Profit Split), intangibles, intra-group services, and Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR).

articles.heading: Arm's Length Principle, Five TP Methods, DEMPE & Documentation
articles.text:
• Arm's Length Principle (Chapter I, MTC Art. 9): controlled transactions between associated enterprises must reflect conditions that independent enterprises would agree to.
• Five Transfer Pricing Methods (Chapter II): Traditional Transaction Methods (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus) and Transactional Profit Methods (TNMM, Transactional Profit Split).
• Intangibles & DEMPE (Chapter VI): profit allocation follows Development, Enhancement, Maintenance, Protection, and Exploitation (DEMPE) functions rather than mere legal ownership.
• Three-Tier Documentation (Chapter V / BEPS Action 13): Master File, Local File, and Country-by-Country Report (CbCR for groups ≥ EUR 750m).
